name: Intro Call with Instantly Studio
summary: Cal.com booking page for an intro call with Hamza of Instantly Studio, covering design needs, process and next steps.
description: A Cal.com scheduling page where visitors book an intro call with Hamza of Instantly Studio, whose profile also offers a 30-minute Quick chat. The profile lists what the call covers: a quick introduction, your project and goals, how we work, and next steps. The booking page renders client-side, so only its title and meta description are readable without a browser.
